title: Huly section heading
description: A huge, very tightly tracked display heading with a short paragraph under it. Optional white-to-lavender gradient fill for dark backdrops.
notes: needs a display font with tight spacing (the huly theme uses Geist)
name: huly-heading

props.name: title
props.description: the heading; pass a list to choose where the lines break on wide screens

props.name: as
props.description: h1 for the page title, h2 for sections

props.name: weight
props.description: semibold (most sections) or medium (the quieter dark sections)

props.name: gradient
props.description: fills the heading with a foreground-to-lavender gradient; made for dark backdrops

props.name: mutedText
props.description: paragraph in the muted colour instead of the softened foreground

props.name: textClassName
props.description: extra classes for the paragraph (e.g. a max width)
